aggregation: Median run-level probe/success rates and successful p95; pooled rejection/error percentages. Runtime means pool staggered samples over three services/repeats. Byte/key peaks use maximum instrumented peak across services/repeats. SQL wait averages divide total duration by acquisitions that waited.
limitations: Local short workload, explicit GC/page cleanup between phases. Sampled memory/goroutine feedback can overshoot or oscillate. Goroutine workers wait; no CPU scheduler-health claim. Source failures/unknown fallback are retained in raw traces.
